title: Probing PXR activation and modulation of CYP3A4 by Tinospora crispa and Tinospora sinensis.
authors: Parveen, Abidah; Alhusban, Manal; Fantoukh, Omer I; Ali, Zulfiqar; Chittiboyina, Amar G; Khan, Ikhlas A; Khan, Shabana I
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物对PXR受体激活及CYP3A4调控，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-核受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The two Tinospora species, T. crispa and T. sinensis, native to Southeast Asia, are integral components of various traditional preparations with structure-function claims to treat various disorders, including diabetes and inflammation. AIM OF THE STUDY: To assure the safety of the botanicals finished products, herb-drug interaction potential of T. crispa and T. sinensis was investigated by testing their extracts and compounds for in vitro activation of the pregnane X-receptor (PXR) and the modulation of CYP3A4 isozyme, selectively. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of sixteen fully characterized phytochemicals from T. crispa and T. sinensis were evaluated for PXR activation by luciferase reporter gene assay. CYP3A4 inhibition studies were carried out for eleven compounds. In addition, docking studies were performed to elucidate the possible binding modes to the PXR by the compounds using computational methods. RESULTS: Significant activation of PXR (2-fold) was observed for both extracts and non-polar fractions of T. crispa. Among the pure compounds, columbin showed highest activation of PXR (3-fold), which was comparable with the positive control, rifampicin. Vital interactions were predicted with docking simulation of PXR-columbin complex with critical amino acid residues (Trp-299) that are known for the activation of PXR. The methanolic extracts of T. crispa and T. sinensis also showed considerable CYP3A4 inhibition. CONCLUSION: T. crispa and T. sinensis, both demonstrated the potential to mediate herb-drug interaction through PXR activation and inhibition of CYP3A4 isozyme. Moreover, the elucidation of the potential to induce herb-drug interaction, by the phytochemicals of these Tinospora plants, thereby supports the need for further investigation to establish the clinical relevancy of these constituents for possible adverse interactions with pharmaceutical drugs.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：原产于东南亚的两种青牛胆属植物——波叶青牛胆（T. crispa）和中华青牛胆（T. sinensis），是多种传统制剂的重要组成部分，这些制剂具有结构-功能宣称，用于治疗包括糖尿病和炎症在内的多种疾病。研究目的：为确保植物成品的安全性，通过测试其提取物和化合物对孕烷X受体（PXR）的体外激活作用及对CYP3A4同工酶的选择性调节，研究了波叶青牛胆和中华青牛胆的药物-草药相互作用潜力。材料与方法：共评估了来自波叶青牛胆和中华青牛胆的十六种充分表征的植物化学物质，通过荧光素酶报告基因测定其PXR激活活性。对十一种化合物进行了CYP3A4抑制研究。此外，进行了对接研究，以通过计算方法阐明这些化合物与PXR的可能结合模式。结果：波叶青牛胆的两种提取物和非极性组分均观察到显著的PXR激活（2倍）。在纯化合物中，columbin显示出最高的PXR激活（3倍），与阳性对照利福平相当。通过PXR-columbin复合物与已知参与PXR激活的关键氨基酸残基（Trp-299）的对接模拟，预测了重要相互作用。波叶青牛胆和中华青牛胆的甲醇提取物也显示出显著的CYP3A4抑制。结论：波叶青牛胆和中华青牛胆均表现出通过PXR激活和CYP3A4同工酶抑制介导药物-草药相互作用的潜力。此外，阐明这些青牛胆属植物的植物化学物质诱导药物-草药相互作用的潜力，支持了进一步研究以确定这些成分与药物可能产生不良相互作用的临床相关性的必要性。
